changelog: 🎨 Global Ace Admin Theme integration across all landing pages, Shield auth views, error templates, and admin dashboard.
🌓 Seamless Dark Mode support with persistent state and automatic system preference detection.
📧 Custom Ace-styled HTML email templates for 2FA, account activation, and magic link authentication.
📱 Android companion app Ace theme alignment (brand colors #438EB9, dynamic theme backgrounds, and dark mode support).
🔒 Standardized HTTP error pages (400, 401, 403, 404, 500, 503) and admin maintenance mode with Ace branding.
🧠 Per-user category rules engine with exact/contains matching, hit telemetry, and isolated retroactive backfill.
🌐 Dynamic versioning API (/api/v1/system/version) serving updated release metadata and changelogs.
